title: Admin console
subtitle: Account and operations only, never user financial data

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.trend_empty: No signups in the last 30 days

users.title: Users
users.notice_no_financial: This view contains no balances, transactions, holdings or goals
users.disable_confirm: Disable this account? All sessions end immediately.
users.revoke_confirm: Revoke all sessions? Issued tokens become invalid immediately.
users.reset_mail_confirm: Send a password reset email to {{email}}?
users.approve_deletion_confirm: {{email}} will be disabled after approval (data retained). Continue?
users.new_hint: Create an account and set its initial password directly
users.create_disabled: Admin-created accounts are off. Enable it in System settings first.
users.edit_description: Adjust nickname, email and language here. For passwords, send a reset email or let the user reset it.
users.edit_email_note: The new email takes effect immediately and is treated as verified.
users.role_hint: Changing the role immediately invalidates this user's existing sessions. Only super admins can change roles, and they cannot change their own.
users.password_note: Leave blank to keep the current password. After setting one, all of this user's sessions end immediately and they must sign in with the new password. Deliver it through a secure channel.
users.delete_confirm: The account will be disabled and marked as deleted. Data is retained but sign-in is blocked. This cannot be undone.
users.delete_soft_hint: Disable the account and mark it as deleted. Financial data is retained for audit or later recovery.
users.delete_permanent_hint: Remove the account and all of its ledger, holdings, goals and reports from the database.
users.delete_permanent_warning: Permanent deletion cannot be undone and requires a super admin.
users.detail_cooling_done: Cooling off elapsed, ready to approve
users.create_description: The account is active immediately and its email is treated as verified.
users.create_password_hint: At least 8 characters with both letters and digits
users.create_role_hint: Admin and super admin can only be created by a super admin
users.create_note: Share the initial password with the user over a secure channel
users.empty_description: Adjust the filters, or create a new user.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what to whom. Actors show a masked email and never financial content.

empty.title: No matching entries
empty.description: Try another action type or widen the date range.

settings.title: System settings
settings.subtitle: Deployment-level switches and runtime parameters. Secrets come from environment variables only.
settings.read_only: Your role can view settings but not change them.
settings.registration_hint: When off, the register endpoint returns 403; existing accounts are unaffected
settings.registration_off_confirm: With registration off, new users cannot sign up on their own. Turn it off?
settings.email_verification_hint: When on, a verification email is sent at signup; unverified users can still log in and use the app
settings.no_mail_confirm: SMTP is not configured, so users will not receive verification emails. Turn it on anyway?
settings.mail_not_configured: Not configured (verification and reset emails will not be sent)
settings.env_hint: These parameters come from environment variables; restart to apply changes.
settings.admin_user_create_hint: When on, super admins can create accounts and set an initial password from the users page; when off, the entry point is disabled
settings.admin_user_create_on_confirm: Admins will set initial passwords for new users and users will not be forced to change them. Turn it on?
settings.admin_user_create_super_only: Only super admins can toggle this

exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.subtitle: Rates are shared system reference data. Changes here affect every user's conversions.
exchangeRates.rate_precision_hint: Lists show four decimals; enter more when you need the extra precision.
exchangeRates.delete_confirm: Deleting this rate makes related conversions report a missing rate for all users. Continue?
exchangeRates.empty_description: Add a rate, or configure an external provider to sync automatically.

stats.pairs_desc: Pairs that have at least one rate
stats.base_currencies_desc: Bases these rates are expressed in
stats.stale_desc: Not updated for more than {{days}} days

sync.busy: A sync is already running. Check back shortly for the result.

syncDrawer.title: Sync settings
syncDrawer.subtitle: Fetch rates from the external provider on the interval you choose.
syncDrawer.scope_hint: Auto-sync never overwrites a rate already entered manually for the same day: manual entries always win.
syncDrawer.not_configured: No usable provider is configured yet. The form below is pre-filled with the default provider — just save to create the configuration and enable auto-sync, or pick a different provider first.
syncDrawer.enable_hint: Fetch on the interval below without manual action

frequency_hint.hourly: Once an hour — suits watching short-term moves.
frequency_hint.daily: Once a day — enough for personal bookkeeping, and the default.
frequency_hint.weekly: Once a week — for long-term trends only.

syncDrawer.auto_disabled: Turned off automatically after repeated failures. Check the provider, then turn it back on.
syncDrawer.last_result: Last sync wrote {{written}} rows and skipped {{skipped}} manually confirmed rows.
syncDrawer.super_admin_only: Only a super admin can change the provider and key. Fields are read-only here.
syncDrawer.super_admin_setup_only: No rate provider is configured yet. Creating the initial configuration requires a super admin.
syncDrawer.source_environment: The current provider comes from deployment environment variables. Saving once here moves it into the admin console, where you can change it anytime.

providers.exchangerate-api_hint: The free public endpoint needs no key and covers the major currencies; adding a key switches to the official endpoint with higher limits.
providers.openexchangerates_hint: Requires a registered app_id. The free tier is fixed to a USD base.
providers.custom_hint: Your own or a third-party endpoint returning a JSON map like {"rates":{"CNY":7.2}}. The base currency is whatever you set below.

syncDrawer.anchor_hint: The currency the provider quotes against — USD for most free sources.
syncDrawer.key_hint: The key is encrypted before storage; only the last four characters are shown.
syncDrawer.key_optional_placeholder: Leave blank to send no key
syncDrawer.key_required: This provider needs a key before syncing can run

history.title: Rate trend
history.inverted_hint: No direct records exist for this direction, so the chart shows the inverse rate.
history.empty_description: This pair has no records in the selected range.

exchangeRates.sync_hint: Pairs that failed the last sync or were rejected by validation. Fill them in manually to avoid users seeing "No data".
exchangeRates.sync_empty: The last sync had no failures.
exchangeRates.create_hint: If a rate already exists for the same pair on that date, it is overwritten and marked manual.

lag.stale: Not updated for more than {{days}} days

bulk.title: Bulk rate entry
bulk.subtitle: Fill one effective date and rate for the {{count}} selected pairs.

editForm.title: Edit rate
editForm.subtitle: Change this rate's value or source; every user conversion updates right away.
editForm.decimals: Quote has {{decimals}} decimals; conversions use the stored precision.
editForm.date_locked: The pair and effective date identify this record; create a new one to change them.
editForm.source_provider_hint: Marked as auto-synced, the next sync may overwrite this value.
editForm.source_manual_hint: Manual entries are authoritative; auto-sync never overwrites the same day.
editForm.rate_invalid: Rate must be a number greater than 0.
editForm.updated_at_hint: Last updated {{time}}. {{decimals}} decimals is the quote's usual precision; conversions use the stored precision.

notice.created_replaced: A rate already existed for that day; overwritten as manual

create.title: New rate
create.subtitle: Add a system reference rate that every user conversion will use.
create.same_currency: Base and quote currency must differ.
create.overwrite_hint: If a rate already exists for the same pair and date, it is overwritten and marked manual.
